name: canva
description: Connect Canva to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Canva MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Canva to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with designs, assets and exports using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Canva workspace.
Find anything in Canva that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review designs, assets and exports in Canva.
